<div class="content simple-texst tt-content tt-column-content">
 <div class="marg-lg-b100 marg-xs-b50"></div>
 <div class="container">
 <div class="row">
 <div class="col-md-12">
<div class="wpb-content-wrapper" id="wpb-content-root"><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_empty_space" ><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Where is Hotel 100% Fun Tarifa located?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Hotel 100% Fun is located in <strong>Valdevaqueros</strong>, on the <strong>N-340, Km 76, 11380 Tarifa, Cádiz (Spain)</strong>. Its location is ideal for anyone looking for a hotel in Tarifa close to <strong>Valdevaqueros Beach</strong>, one of the area’s best-known spots to enjoy the sea, nature and wind sports.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Is Hotel 100% Fun close to Valdevaqueros Beach?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes. Hotel 100% Fun is just a short walk from <strong>Valdevaqueros Beach</strong>, a wide, fine-sand beach stretching over <strong>4 kilometres</strong>. It’s a perfect setting if you want to stay near the sea and enjoy one of Tarifa’s most spectacular landscapes.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Is Hotel 100% Fun a good option for kitesurfing in Tarifa?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes. Hotel 100% Fun is highly recommended if you’re looking for accommodation for <strong>kitesurfing in Tarifa</strong>. The hotel is located in Valdevaqueros, one of the most popular areas for wind sports, very close to the beach and specialist kitesurf schools.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Does Hotel 100% Fun have its own kitesurf school?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>No. Hotel 100% Fun does not have its own kitesurf school, but we can recommend the best school near the hotel, with professional instructors and lessons for different levels. It’s ideal both for beginners and for those looking to improve their technique during their stay in Tarifa.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>What types of rooms does Hotel 100% Fun Tarifa offer?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Hotel 100% Fun offers several room types in Tarifa, including <strong>garden-view suites, a Balinese suite, quadruple rooms, sea-view suites, a sea-view junior suite, Superior Double rooms and Standard Double rooms</strong>. It’s a comfortable choice for couples’ getaways, family trips and sports holidays.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Does Hotel 100% Fun allow pets?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>No. Hotel 100% Fun Tarifa does <strong>not</strong> allow pets on the premises. If you’re planning your stay in Tarifa, please keep this in mind before booking.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Is Hotel 100% Fun recommended for a family getaway in Tarifa?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes. The hotel is a great option for families who want to stay near the beach in Tarifa. It offers spacious rooms, a pool, breakfast included and a peaceful natural setting—ideal for combining rest, beach time and outdoor plans.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Does Hotel 100% Fun have parking or an EV charger?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes. Hotel 100% Fun has <strong>parking</strong> and an <strong>electric vehicle (EV) charger</strong>, which is very convenient for guests travelling to Tarifa by electric car and looking for accommodation near Valdevaqueros Beach.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Does the hotel have a restaurant in Tarifa?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes. <strong>Restaurant 100% Fun</strong> offers a carefully curated dining experience, based on quality produce and flavours designed to be enjoyed in a relaxed atmosphere in Tarifa. It’s a great choice both for hotel guests and for anyone looking to have lunch or dinner near Valdevaqueros.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Is breakfast included at Hotel 100% Fun?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes. <strong>Breakfast is included</strong>, with a varied selection such as fresh fruit, breads, eggs, coffee, teas, cereals and other options—perfect for starting the day with energy before heading out to enjoy Tarifa, Valdevaqueros or a day of kitesurfing.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Can I go to breakfast or the restaurant without staying at the hotel?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes. You can also enjoy breakfast or dine at the restaurant even if you are not staying at the hotel. This is ideal for local searches such as “breakfast in Valdevaqueros”, “restaurant in Tarifa” or “breakfast near Valdevaqueros Beach”.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Does Hotel 100% Fun have a chill-out area in Tarifa?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes. Hotel 100% Fun has a chill-out area with cocktails, live music and a relaxed vibe to enjoy Tarifa near Valdevaqueros. <strong>Chill-out opening times may vary depending on the season</strong>, so we recommend checking availability before your visit or during the booking process.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Can weddings or events be held at Hotel 100% Fun?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes. Hotel 100% Fun offers spaces for celebrations in Tarifa, including <strong>weddings, christenings, communions, birthdays, anniversaries and private parties</strong>. Its tropical gardens, on-site restaurant and proximity to the sea make it a very attractive option for events on the Cádiz coast.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>What can you do near Hotel 100% Fun in Tarifa?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>From Hotel 100% Fun you can enjoy Valdevaqueros Beach, practise kitesurfing, windsurfing or wingfoiling, visit Bolonia and Baelo Claudia, go hiking, explore the Strait of Gibraltar Natural Park, take trips to Tangier, or enjoy Tarifa’s local gastronomy.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_do_toggle vc_toggle vc_toggle_default vc_toggle_size_md"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Why book direct with Hotel 100% Fun Tarifa?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Booking directly through the Hotel 100% Fun website gives you access to the <strong>best direct rate guaranteed</strong> and special offers for getaways, stays and experiences in Tarifa. It’s the best way to check availability and take advantage of exclusive promotions.</p>
</div></div><div class="vc_empty_space" ><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div></div></div></div></div>
